title: AirtimeTransaction

to_number.description: Destination phone number in international format (no leading +)

time_created.description: The time that the airtime transaction was created on Telerivet's servers

transaction_time.description: The time that the airtime transaction was sent, or null if it has not been sent

status.description: Current status of airtime transaction (`successful`, `failed`, `cancelled`, `queued`, `processing`, `submitted`, `pending_approval`, or `pending_payment`)

status_text.description: Error or success message returned by airtime provider, if available

value.description: Value of airtime sent to destination phone number, in units of value_currency

price.description: Price charged for airtime transaction, in units of price_currency

contact_id.description: ID of the contact the airtime was sent to

service_id.description: ID of the service that sent the airtime

project_id.description: ID of the project that the airtime transaction belongs to

external_id.description: The ID of this transaction from an external airtime gateway provider, if available.

user_id.description: ID of the Telerivet user who sent the airtime transaction (if applicable)

vars.description:
Custom variables stored for this transaction. Variable names may be up to 32 characters in length and can contain the characters a-z, A-Z, 0-9, and _.
 Values may be strings, numbers, or boolean (true/false).
 String values may be up to 4096 bytes in length when encoded as UTF-8.
 Up to 100 variables are supported per object.
 Setting a variable to null will delete the variable.

description:
Represents a transaction where airtime is sent to a mobile phone number. This also is used to represent non-airtime value transfers such as data bundles or gift cards.

To send airtime, first [create a Custom Actions service to send a particular amount of airtime](https://telerivet.com/dashboard/add_service?subtype_id=main.service.rules.contact&action_id=main.rule.sendairtime), then trigger the service using service.invoke, project.sendBroadcast, or project.scheduleMessage.
